summary: A monthly "Capper + Mastermind" peer group for Keller Williams Professionals real estate agents in Asheville, held at the brokerage's 48 Grove Street office. It targets agents who have hit (or are near) their KW commission cap, with structured discussion, accountability check-ins, and strategy sharing among a specific tier of producers. "Capper Mastermind" is a recognized, recurring format used at other Keller Williams offices nationally, each with its own local, repeating cohort of agents rather than a rotating public audience.

evidence.note: 8 monthly listings Dec 2025-Oct 2026, all free, same venue (Keller Williams Professionals office), described as 'peer-led mastermind... structured discussion, accountability check-ins, and practical strategy sharing.'

Tags include 'Agent Community', 'Agent Mastermind', 'Capper Meetup', 'Small Group', 'Agents Only', 'Keller Williams' - signaling a bounded, recurring membership of real estate agents rather than a general public audience.

Eventbrite page fetch: 'For agents ready to level up - advanced tactics, mindset shifts, and systems to go beyond the cap and build a sustainable, thriving real estate business,' organized by Keller Williams Professionals; no separate outside website or social page found.

Search found 'The Official Keller Williams Cappers Mastermind' Facebook group and similarly-named 'Capper Mastermind' events at other KW offices (e.g. KW Legacy Apex, NC), confirming this is a known recurring peer-mastermind format for a specific production-tier cohort of agents, not a one-off class.

No independent website, Meetup, or Instagram presence found specifically for 'Beyond the Cap Collective' beyond its Eventbrite listing and its parent brokerage; it appears to be internal to Keller Williams Professionals' Asheville office.
